name: github_reporting
comment: Approved live GitHub reporting. Complete keyed listings; search is capped discovery.

repository_count.comment: Visible repositories owned by the selected account, in a complete listing.

repository_stars.comment: Current repository stars; one observation, never a historical sum.

issue_count.comment: All listed issues, excluding pull requests.

open_issues.comment: Current open issues; not historical backlog.

closed_issues.comment: Issues currently closed, including repeated reopening/closing as one issue.

mean_issue_close_hours.comment: Mean recorded closure duration for currently closed issues.
mean_issue_close_hours.population: issues.state = 'closed' AND issues.closed_at IS NOT NULL

pull_request_count.comment: All pull requests in the complete selected repository population.

open_pull_requests.comment: Current open pull requests, including drafts.

closed_unmerged_pull_requests.comment: Closed pull requests with no merge timestamp.

merged_prs.comment: Merged pull requests, including bots and draft waiting time.

mean_merge_hours.comment: Mean elapsed hours; NULL for an empty merge cohort.

median_merge_hours.comment: Exact continuous median elapsed hours; NULL for empty cohort.

p90_merge_hours.comment: Exact continuous 90th percentile elapsed hours; non-additive.

total_merge_hours.comment: Sum elapsed hours; combine with merged_prs for a weighted mean.

issue_comment_count.comment: Conversation comments on the selected issue or PR; excludes review comments.

commit_count.comment: Distinct listed commit identities on the default branch, using committer date for date reports.

verified_commit_count.comment: Listed commits whose signatures GitHub reports verified.

published_releases.comment: Published stable releases; excludes drafts and prereleases.
published_releases.population: releases.is_draft = FALSE AND releases.is_prerelease = FALSE AND releases.published_at IS NOT NULL

prereleases.population: releases.is_draft = FALSE AND releases.is_prerelease = TRUE AND releases.published_at IS NOT NULL

release_asset_downloads.comment: Current cumulative downloads of attached assets, excluding generated source archives; not downloads during the report interval.

contributor_count.comment: Contributors returned by GitHub's attributed default-branch contributor endpoint.

attributed_commits.comment: GitHub contributor contributions; not interchangeable with commit-history row count.

language_count.comment: Languages with entries in the current repository language response.

language_bytes.comment: Current linguist-attributed bytes; not lines of code.

current_stargazers.comment: Currently visible stargazers; unstars disappear and no historical net-star metric is implied.

workflow_run_count.comment: Latest reported attempt of each run, one row per run ID; not all attempts.

successful_runs.comment: Runs whose latest reported conclusion is success.

failed_runs.comment: Runs whose latest reported conclusion is failure.

timed_out_runs.comment: Runs whose latest reported conclusion is timed_out.

cancelled_runs.comment: Runs whose latest reported conclusion is cancelled.

eligible_runs.comment: Reliability denominator: success, failure and timed_out only.

ci_success_rate.comment: Success / (success + failure + timed_out), from latest reported run outcomes; NULL for zero denominator.

repo.full_name.comment: Repository as 'owner/name' — the key every per-repository function takes.

repo.id.comment: GitHub's numeric repository id; survives renames and transfers.

repo.owner_login.comment: Login of the user or organization that owns the repository.

repo.owner_type.comment: Whether the owner is a 'User' or an 'Organization'.

repo.description.comment: The one-line description shown on the repository page.

repo.html_url.comment: Link to the repository on github.com.

repo.homepage.comment: Project website the owner configured, if any.

repo.language.comment: Dominant language by bytes, as GitHub's linguist detects it.

repo.topics.comment: Topic tags the owner applied, e.g. ['database', 'sql'].

repo.license_spdx_id.comment: SPDX identifier of the detected license, e.g. 'MIT'.

repo.is_fork.comment: Whether this repository is a fork of another.

repo.is_template.comment: Whether the repository is a template for new repositories.

repo.default_branch.comment: Branch commits() lists when no sha is given, e.g. 'main'.

repo.stargazers_count.comment: Number of users who starred the repository.

repo.open_issues_count.comment: Open issues PLUS open pull requests — GitHub counts both here, so this is not the open-issue count alone.

repo.watchers_count.comment: Despite the name, GitHub reports the stargazer count here; kept for fidelity. Use stargazers_count.

repo.size_kb.comment: Repository size on disk in kilobytes, as GitHub measures it.

repo.has_issues.comment: Whether the issue tracker is enabled.

repo.updated_at.comment: When the repository object last changed (including stars); not a code-activity signal.

repo.pushed_at.comment: When a commit was last pushed to any branch; the activity signal.

user_input.login.comment: User or organization login, e.g. 'torvalds' or 'duckdb'

user.login.comment: The account's handle — the key user() and repos() take.

user.id.comment: GitHub's numeric account id; survives a login rename.

user.blog.comment: Website the account lists, if any.

user.email.comment: Public email, if the account chose to publish one.

user.public_repos.comment: Number of public repositories the account owns.

user.following.comment: Number of accounts this one follows.

user.html_url.comment: Link to the profile on github.com.

repos_input.owner.comment: User or organization login whose repositories to list

repos.full_name.comment: Repository as 'owner/name' — the key every per-repository function takes.

repos.id.comment: GitHub's numeric repository id; survives renames and transfers.

repos.owner_login.comment: Login of the user or organization that owns the repository.

repos.owner_type.comment: Whether the owner is a 'User' or an 'Organization'.

repos.description.comment: The one-line description shown on the repository page.

repos.html_url.comment: Link to the repository on github.com.

repos.homepage.comment: Project website the owner configured, if any.

repos.language.comment: Dominant language by bytes, as GitHub's linguist detects it.

repos.topics.comment: Topic tags the owner applied, e.g. ['database', 'sql'].

repos.license_spdx_id.comment: SPDX identifier of the detected license, e.g. 'MIT'.

repos.is_fork.comment: Whether this repository is a fork of another.

repos.is_template.comment: Whether the repository is a template for new repositories.

repos.default_branch.comment: Branch commits() lists when no sha is given, e.g. 'main'.

repos.stargazers_count.comment: Number of users who starred the repository.

repos.open_issues_count.comment: Open issues PLUS open pull requests — GitHub counts both here, so this is not the open-issue count alone.

repos.watchers_count.comment: Despite the name, GitHub reports the stargazer count here; kept for fidelity. Use stargazers_count.

repos.size_kb.comment: Repository size on disk in kilobytes, as GitHub measures it.

repos.has_issues.comment: Whether the issue tracker is enabled.

repos.updated_at.comment: When the repository object last changed (including stars); not a code-activity signal.

repos.pushed_at.comment: When a commit was last pushed to any branch; the activity signal.

issues.repo.comment: Repository the issue belongs to, as 'owner/name'.

issues.number.comment: Issue number within the repository — what issue_comments() takes.

issues.state_reason.comment: Why it is in its state: 'completed', 'not_planned', 'reopened' or 'duplicate'; NULL when unset.

issues.user_login.comment: Login of the account that opened the issue.

issues.author_association.comment: The author's relationship to the repository: OWNER, MEMBER, COLLABORATOR, CONTRIBUTOR, FIRST_TIME_CONTRIBUTOR, FIRST_TIMER or NONE.

issues.labels.comment: Names of the labels applied to the issue.

issues.assignees.comment: Logins of everyone assigned to the issue.

issues.milestone.comment: Title of the milestone the issue is filed under, if any.

issues.comments.comment: Number of comments on the issue.

issues.reactions_total.comment: Total reactions of every kind on the issue body.

issues.reactions_plus_one.comment: Thumbs-up reactions — the usual 'me too' signal.

issues.is_pull_request.comment: Whether this row is a pull request. GitHub's issue APIs return both; issues() excludes pull requests by default, search_issues() includes them unless the query says is:issue.

issues.html_url.comment: Link to the issue on github.com.

issues.updated_at.comment: When the issue last changed, including new comments.

issues.closed_at.comment: When the issue was closed; NULL while open.

pulls.repo.comment: Repository the pull request targets, as 'owner/name'.

pulls.number.comment: Pull request number — shared with the issue namespace.

pulls.id.comment: GitHub's globally unique pull request id.

pulls.state.comment: 'open' or 'closed'. A merged pull request is 'closed' — test merged_at IS NOT NULL for merged.

pulls.is_draft.comment: Whether the pull request is a draft.

pulls.author_association.comment: The author's relationship to the repository.

pulls.head_repo.comment: Repository the head branch lives in ('owner/name'); differs for forks.

pulls.head_sha.comment: Commit at the tip of the head branch.

pulls.base_ref.comment: Branch the changes would merge into.

pulls.milestone.comment: Title of the milestone, if any.

pulls.merge_commit_sha.comment: The merge (or squash) commit once merged.

pulls.html_url.comment: Link to the pull request on github.com.

pulls.created_at.comment: When the pull request was opened.

pulls.closed_at.comment: When it was closed or merged; NULL while open.

pulls.merged_at.comment: When it was merged; NULL if it was closed unmerged or is open.

issue_comments.repo.comment: Repository the comment belongs to, as 'owner/name'.

issue_comments.issue_number.comment: Issue or pull request the comment is on.

issue_comments.author_association.comment: The commenter's relationship to the repository.

issue_comments.html_url.comment: Link to the comment on github.com.

issue_comments.updated_at.comment: When the comment was last edited.

commits.repo.comment: Repository the commit was listed from, as 'owner/name'.

commits.message.comment: Full commit message; the first line is the summary.

commits.author_name.comment: Author name as recorded in the commit (git metadata).

commits.author_email.comment: Author email as recorded in the commit.

commits.author_date.comment: When the change was originally authored.

commits.author_login.comment: GitHub account matched to the author email; NULL when the email maps to no account.

commits.committer_name.comment: Committer name as recorded in the commit.

commits.committer_email.comment: Committer email as recorded in the commit.

commits.committer_date.comment: When the commit was applied — differs from author_date after a rebase or cherry-pick.

commits.committer_login.comment: GitHub account matched to the committer email.

commits.parent_shas.comment: Parent commit hashes; more than one means a merge commit.

commits.is_verified.comment: Whether GitHub verified the commit's signature.

commits.html_url.comment: Link to the commit on github.com.

releases.repo.comment: Repository the release belongs to, as 'owner/name'.

releases.tag_name.comment: Git tag the release points at, e.g. 'v1.2.0'.

releases.name.comment: Release title; often the same as the tag.

releases.is_draft.comment: Whether the release is an unpublished draft (visible only with push access).

releases.is_prerelease.comment: Whether the release is marked as a pre-release.

releases.author_login.comment: Login of the account that created the release.

releases.target_commitish.comment: Branch or commit the tag was created from.

releases.download_count.comment: Total downloads across all attached assets. Source archives GitHub generates automatically are not counted.

releases.html_url.comment: Link to the release on github.com.

releases.created_at.comment: When the release's commit was created.

releases.published_at.comment: When the release was published; NULL for a draft.

contributors.login.comment: Contributor's login — feed it to user() for their profile.

contributors.contributions.comment: Commits to the default branch attributed to this account.

languages.language.comment: Language name as GitHub's linguist reports it.

languages.bytes.comment: Bytes of code in this language; divide by the repo's sum for a share.

stargazers.starred_at.comment: When the star was given; the column a star-history chart is built on.

stargazers.login.comment: Login of the account that starred.

workflow_runs.repo.comment: Repository the run belongs to, as 'owner/name'.

workflow_runs.workflow_id.comment: Numeric id of the workflow definition that ran.

workflow_runs.run_attempt.comment: Attempt number; above 1 means the run was re-run.

workflow_runs.conclusion.comment: Outcome once completed: 'success', 'failure', 'cancelled', 'skipped', 'timed_out', 'action_required', 'neutral' or 'stale'; NULL until the run completes.

workflow_runs.head_branch.comment: Branch the run was triggered on.

workflow_runs.actor_login.comment: Account whose action triggered the run.

workflow_runs.html_url.comment: Link to the run on github.com.

workflow_runs.run_started_at.comment: When the current attempt started executing.

workflow_runs.updated_at.comment: When the run last changed; for a completed run, effectively when it finished.

all_rate_limit.resource.comment: Which budget this row describes: 'core' (most endpoints), 'search', 'graphql', ...

all_rate_limit.request_limit.comment: Requests allowed per window: 60/hour anonymously, 5,000 with a token.

all_rate_limit.used.comment: Requests spent in the current window.

all_rate_limit.remaining.comment: Count of requests left before the window resets.

all_rate_limit.reset_at.comment: When the window resets and remaining returns to request_limit.

all_rate_limit.authenticated.comment: Whether these figures are for a token (true) or this IP's anonymous budget (false).

pulls.merge_hours.comment: Elapsed creation-to-merge hours, including draft and waiting time; not review or business hours.

issues.close_hours.comment: Elapsed creation to currently recorded closure; not time spent in open state across reopenings.

user.comment: One GitHub user or organization profile by login

repos.comment: Repositories owned by a GitHub user or organization

issues.comment: Issues in a GitHub repository, newest first

pulls.comment: Pull requests in a GitHub repository, newest first

issue_comments.comment: Comments on a GitHub issue or pull request

commits.comment: Commit history of a GitHub repository, newest first

releases.comment: Releases of a GitHub repository, newest first

contributors.comment: Contributors to a GitHub repository, most commits first

languages.comment: Bytes of code per language in a GitHub repository

stargazers.comment: Stars on a GitHub repository with when each was given, oldest first

workflow_runs.comment: GitHub Actions workflow runs for a repository, newest first

search_repositories.comment: Search GitHub repositories with GitHub's query syntax

search_issues.comment: Search GitHub issues and pull requests with GitHub's query syntax

all_rate_limit.comment: GitHub API rate-limit budgets (the scan backing the `rate_limit` table)

owner.comment: User or organization login whose repositories to list
